problem_type: unverified catalog rows block canonical model certification
symptom: The APIMart onboarding picker labels an unverified seeded model as already added, so the user cannot select it and start canonical certification.
direct_cause: Both buildExistingConnectionSummary and the main-process resolveConnection path forwarded catalog rows as existingModels; the latter replaced the renderer-filtered summary after remote discovery, while staged vendor identity also isolated a newly selected unverified model whenever an unrelated sibling was published, so certification either suppressed the picker row or promoted into a vendor the caller did not inspect.
class_root: The onboarding and staging projections had no enforced distinction between staged/unverified rows, certified published rows, and selected-model publication predecessors across renderer, main-process, and candidate-identity boundaries, allowing unverified rows to suppress the canonical add-and-certify action or strand its result in an unnecessary candidate vendor.
affected_population: Users onboarding a provider whose catalog contains seeded or previously staged models
The M0-M5 runner certifying APIMart deepseek-v4-pro after visible key onboarding
entry_points: Visible model settings connection add flow
internal_only_reason: The defect is in Nomi's catalog-to-onboarding projection and does not depend on an external contract.
invariants: Only enabled models with published execution and verified adapter state are immutable already-added rows.
Disabled or unverified seeded rows remain selectable for the canonical certification flow.
Certification continues through the visible picker and onboarding.httpCertificationStartExisting; direct renderer enable remains forbidden.
generality_proof: All known and custom provider connection add flows use buildExistingConnectionSummary and the shared ChipModel projection, so filtering at this boundary covers every provider without vendor-specific branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project only certified published rows as existingModels for the canonical picker.
Carry catalog publication state into the shared ChipModel projection.
Return only certified published catalog rows in the public existingModels summary used after remote discovery.
Isolate only selections with a published model predecessor; keep new unverified models on the stable vendor even when unrelated siblings are published.
Treat a deliberately disabled known vendor as unpublished so certification promotes its stable vendor key.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: known and custom provider existing connection summary
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The shared summary filter requires enabled, published, and adapterState=verified.
The picker consumes existingModels from the shared summary and keeps its duplicate guard unchanged.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: main-process existing connection list after remote model discovery
same_class_entry_points.evidence: resolveConnection now requires enabled, published execution, and adapter state verified before returning an existing row.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: candidate allocation for selected model certification
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Candidate isolation now depends on a published predecessor among the selected model keys, preserving the stable source key for new models alongside published siblings.

recurrence.reason: Any provider can contain staged or unverified rows before canonical certification.
same_class_scan: Searched all buildExistingConnectionSummary callers and ExistingConnectionModelPicker entry points.
Searched main-process resolveConnection/listModels callers that can replace the renderer summary.
Compared modelSettingsCatalogProjection output with listModelCatalogModels publication fields.
Added regression cases covering certified, disabled, unpublished, unverified, and published-sibling candidate identity rows.

prevention.invariant: The duplicate guard receives only certified published rows; staged rows must remain selectable.
prevention.failure_mode: If publication metadata is missing or adapter state is not verified, the row is treated as selectable and canonical certification remains the only promotion path.
prevention.strategy: Filter existingModels once at the shared projection boundary and retain publication state in ChipModel for explicit checks.

legacy_paths.rationale: The shared projection is tightened in place; no alternate picker path is retained.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency is introduced or removed.

migration: No persisted catalog migration is needed; publication and adapter metadata are already part of the catalog DTO.
residual_risks: A real provider certification still requires a valid APIMart credential and network request; no provider call is made by the no-key validation run.
Real Codex Host to Nomi MCP acceptance remains a separate uncovered gate in the vertical runner.
